page.overview:
Who is Eselmyr?

Eselmyr is a singer in Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe. As an NPC, Eselmyr is played by Matthew Mercer.

Eselmyr is a half-elven woman in her later years. She keeps her hair tied back into a very tight bun.

Eselmyr was singing a song as part of Dr. Dranzel's troupe when Vox Machina ran into them at the Diamond Nest Tavern in Emon.

Eselmyr was with the rest of Dr. Dranzel's troupe when Vox Machina met them at Greyskull Keep. She was mentioned by name for the first (and only) time in this episode.
